All the source documents are scattered under /data/2025/ — there are payslips, rental records, consulting invoices, deduction receipts, and family details. Some of the files are messy or have duplicate entries that need to be handled carefully. There's also older data from 2024 in /data/2024/ which should NOT be included.

Please process all the 2025 income sources, figure out the applicable deductions and family tax credits, and produce a file called `e1_summary_2025.json` with a complete tax breakdown. The accountant will use this to prepare the official filing.
